It starts with you picking a single file / folder / zip. 
Then, depending on your settings (in menu/options) there is 2 possibilities : 
 
option 1 [copy] :default Bookplayer will first, copy the audio inside Bookplayer internal app memory, and then read it from there. 
 
option 2 [no copy] : Bookplayer will just register the location so as to directly play audio from the general device memory (E.g. from the Download folder, the Music folder or any folder) 
 
(Note that ZIP files are always copied. This option is only for single files and folders) 
 
With option 1 (copy), you won't need the [Read Audio] permission. 
Also, if you delete the file from main memory, or move it, that won't matter. You will not loose your book and progress. 
 
With option 2 (no copy), you may save space. 
 
There is another setting, in menu/options, that allows you to automatically delete the source file, once it has been imported. 
Activate that one if all the books you load into Bookplayer will not be needed by another app.

"If you have troubles importing your audio : 
ZIP : In filepicker, if a click on a zip shows the content of the zip instead of letting you select the zip , try a long click on the zip. 
ZIP : If Unzip fails, try tp unzip them before with another app. 
If problem with picking audios from Download folder, try to move them out of 'Download' folder."

A specific view to check the content of the Bookplayer internal memory does now exist. 
 
It allows you to see which books do take a lot of room. You can delete some of them from here. 
 
Please note that will show there, only books that have been copied inside Bookplayer internal reserved memory. 
That is to say, all audios from ZIP file, + all audios from Single File / Folder, that have been loaded with the [copy] setting on (in menu/options)

"BookPlayer can run without any permission. 
There is 3 main permissions : 
[Music and Audio] = [Read Audio] = [External Storage] : Allows to read audio from the general device memory, if copy option was unselected (like from the download folder, the music folder, or any other one) 

[Microphone] (= [Record Audio]) is needed to display a frequency visualizer animation (sound spectrum display). If it is denied, it will just not show, no problem. 

[Notifications] may be needed on some devices (Android 14+). It is used to display the command widget on the lock screen. (Usually it displays straight away without permission being even asked.)
Argg : automatic pause duration out of bounds, reset back to default

string.name: option_copy_file_subtitle
string.i:
Pros : 
* [Read Audio] permission is not needed. 
* No risk to loose audio book and progress if its source file get accidentally deleted/moved. 
Cons : 
* More memory will be needed if you do not delete the source file.

string.name: option_delete_source_file_subtitle
string.i:
After a file/folder/zip has been loaded into BookPlayer, the source file/folder/zip you picked can be deleted automatically. 
Note that this is only possible if the audio has been copied in the internal memory. 
* ZIP files are always copied internally. 
* Single audio file, and audio Folders, are copied only if the above option [copy file internally] is set.
